answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. This economic sacrifice acts as a signal of commitment, preventing the formation of a plume of low-value fake identities. Since every sybil node incurs a marginal cost exceeding its influence, the dawn of a secure agent economy relies on this financial barrier to ensure that rational actors cannot profitably flood the network with fraudulent nodes.
